title: Held Note
subject: a long train tunnel
caption: Melodic techno. A four-on-the-floor drum machine with a tight closed hat and a long sidechained pad, rolling sub bass, an arpeggiated analog synth that slowly opens its filter across the track, one detuned lead that arrives at the halfway point. An ethereal female soprano sings wordless vowels through the verses and a single repeated line on the drop, drenched in cavernous reverb. Wide stereo image, granular textures in the breakdown. 122 BPM, D minor. Hypnotic, weightless.
